name: Sakuubian
description: Sakuubians were the native species of Sakuub. They were humanoids with blue skin, yellow cat-like eyes, distinctive facial ridges, three-fingered hands, and four horns on their forehead. Dular and Pharika were Sakuubians. Nevertheless, it was unsure whether Pharika was a true Sakuubian or was simply wearing a disguise.
